annotations.title: Check the files you have installed

description: Hand over the sha256 of each agent markdown file your project has installed (up to 50; sha256sum .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md gives them, mdr.lock already holds them) and get back, for each one: which public file and version those exact bytes are, how many newer versions exist, and the grade then and now. Bytes that match no version anyone published are said so plainly: a local edit, or a copy from somewhere this registry has not seen.

path.description: Where it sits in your project, echoed back so you can match the answers.

ref.description: Optional: the file you installed it from, when the same bytes are saved in several.

name: check_installed
title: Check the files you have installed
